subject: Contract closure sprint: MSA / DPA / Order Form dependency grid
messages:
From: Marta Gomez <marta.gomez@heliomed.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: Contracts Team <contracts@heliomed.com>, ricardo.villa@heliomed.com
Date: Sun, 10 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps for pilot — legal & procurement sequencing

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement asked that we send a clear sequence for legal approvals — specifically how the MSA, DPA, and order form tie into the pilot acceptance milestones. They want an approximate schedule and a single owner at each gate so we can present to legal on Friday.

Can you provide:
- A short dependency grid (what must be signed before pilot start vs what can be post-pilot)
- Proposed owners from Redwood for each item (MSA redlines, DPA review, order form acceptance criteria)
- Any early docs we can circulate to internal legal to speed review

I've attached our intake checklist (see attachment stub).

Appreciate a quick turnaround — our CFO is on a tight review cadence.

Best,
Marta
Head of Procurement | HelioMed
[Attachment: HelioMed_Procurement_Checklist.pdf (pdf)]

From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Gomez <marta.gomez@heliomed.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps for pilot — legal & procurement sequencing

Marta — thanks for the clear ask. I’m attaching a one-page dependency grid and a working MAP (attached XLSX). Below is a concise plan we can present to legal on Friday.

Quick overview (high level):
- Pre-pilot sign: Order Form (signed) + limited MSA signature with scoped pilot SOW clause OR signature with an early termination/limited liability carveout.
- Parallel review: DPA to be reviewed during pilot; we can provide a DPA draft and annotated checklist to HelioMed legal.
- Post-pilot: Full MSA acceptance of production terms and final Order Form amendment for committed capacity.

Proposed owners (Redwood):
- MSA redlines: laura_bennett (legal lead)
- DPA technical annex and security appendix: kimberly_park (security/compliance)
- Order Form acceptance criteria / pilot SOW: jonas_weber (AM) + aditya_rao (solutions)

Key dates for presentation:
- Draft MAP + dependency grid shared: 2026-05-12 (attached)
- Legal kickoff (HelioMed + Redwood): 2026-05-14 09:30 PT
- HelioMed initial redlines due: 2026-05-18
- Pilot start target: 2026-06-01 (contingent on order form signature)

Attachments included: RWI-HelioMed_MAP_v0.2.xlsx (action grid), high-level dependency diagram.

If that schedule looks tight for HelioMed, we can propose a tabled pilot start and run the evaluation in a short 'onboarding hold' where we limit data retention to meet DPA concerns until the DPA is signed.

Jonas Weber
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: RWI-HelioMed_MAP_v0.2.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 15 May 2026 08:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps for pilot — legal & procurement sequencing

On Tue, 12 May 2026 11:08, jonas_weber@redwood.ai wrote:
> If that schedule looks tight for HelioMed, we can propose a tabled pilot start...

Quick internal note before the legal kickoff:
- I reviewed their intake checklist and flagged three recurring redline themes we should pre-authorize: indemnity cap language, data residency carveouts, and audit scope.
- I'll prepare a redlines_summary_helio_20260515.pdf that explains which clauses we are willing to accept for pilot vs. which we need fully negotiated before production. That will help speed Friday’s conversation.

Kimberly — can you confirm the DPA/technical annex items you need (encryption-at-rest, subprocessor list, SOC2 evidence package). I will include that list in my packet.

Aditya — please flesh out the pilot SOW acceptance criteria in the MAP workbook (rows: acceptance tests, pass/fail thresholds, data retention during pilot). We need clear gates so procurement is comfortable signing the order form for a limited-scope pilot.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redlines_summary_helio_20260515.pdf (pdf)]

From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Cc: Marta Gomez <marta.gomez@heliomed.com>, Contracts Team <contracts@heliomed.com>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps for pilot — legal & procurement sequencing

On Fri, 15 May 2026 08:21, laura_bennett@redwood.ai wrote:
> Kimberly — can you confirm the DPA/technical annex items you need...

Folks — thank you. For the kickoff on Thursday I’ve drafted a DPA checklist to reduce back-and-forth. Key items we will provide up-front:
- Draft DPA (with security annex) for HelioMed review
- SOC 2 Type II summary and auditor contact (redacted)
- Encryption details: AES-256 at rest, TLS 1.3 in transit, key management via customer KMS for Private deployments
- Subprocessor list + standard flow for notification and approval

Pilot-specific mitigations we can offer to bridge the signatures:
- Limited data scope clause in the order form (pilot-only dataset + retention 30 days)
- Audit window limited to Redwood-managed production environments (no on-prem audits during pilot)

Action items / owners (recap):
- jonas_weber: send updated MAP to HelioMed and confirm kickoff time (today) — DONE
- laura_bennett: finalize redlines summary (deliverable: redlines_summary_helio_20260515.pdf) — IN PROGRESS
- kimberly_park: upload DPA draft + annex (deliverable: DPA_draft_RWI_helio_20260518.docx) — READY FOR KICKOFF
- aditya_rao: complete pilot acceptance criteria in MAP workbook — ASAP

Next milestone dates (agreed):
- Legal kickoff: 2026-05-19 09:30 PT (confirmed on calendar)
- HelioMed redlines due: 2026-05-25
- Target to sign pilot order form (limited-scope): 2026-05-28

Cc’ing HelioMed procurement to confirm those dates. If they need faster turnaround for CFO review we can compress the cycle by providing marked-up language up-front (we already included the main concessions).

Kimberly Park
Head of Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: DPA_draft_RWI_helio_20260518.docx (docx)]
